rci2_using_epd.detail: Normative model reference cohort is the CNP discovery HC sample; no EPD from the listed set is explicitly used for model training.
rci2_using_epd.supporting_text: "The discovery dataset was sourced from the University of California, Los Angeles (UCLA) Consortium for Neuropsychiatric Phenomics (CNP), accessible via the public database OpenfMRI"

rci3_epd_name.detail: COBRE HCs (n=73 after exclusions per Table S1) are part of the normative reference cohort. CNP (UCLA Consortium for Neuropsychiatric Phenomics, via OpenfMRI) and DIRECT are not in the EPD list. Note: DIRECT site 20 is associated with the REST-meta-MDD project (per supplementary reference Chen et al. 2022), but the paper identifies this dataset as 'DIRECT' (not REST-meta-MDD) and uses only a single site (site 20) specifically to avoid multi-site effects; it is not counted as the REST-meta-MDD EPD here.
rci3_epd_name.supporting_text: "Validation dataset 1 was obtained from the Center for Biomedical Research Excellence (COBRE), accessible at http://fcon_1000.projects.nitrc.org/indi/retro/cobre.html"
